# dataiku_group (Data Source)

Reads a single Dataiku DSS group by name. Requires an API key with admin rights.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataiku_group" "administrators" {
  name = "administrators"
}

# definition_json is the quickest way to discover which ability field names
# your DSS version supports before setting them on a dataiku_group resource.
output "administrator_abilities" {
  value = data.dataiku_group.administrators.definition_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group to read.

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether members of the group are DSS administrators.
- `definition_json` (String) The group's full definition as returned by DSS, as a JSON object. Use this to discover the ability field names your DSS version supports before setting them in a `dataiku_group` resource's `permissions` map.
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (String) The group name.
- `ldap_group_names` (String) LDAP group names mapped to this group.
- `source_type` (String) Where the group is defined, `LOCAL` or `LDAP`.
